jobs.name: sheet-left-original-view-v3
jobs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: transparent sprite sheet for a cozy illustrated cat room, three independent furniture assets.
Input image: original-room-1-1.png is the ONLY visual style and perspective reference. Match its small raised cat house in the LOWER LEFT (ignore the large tall central cat tree). Do not redraw the room.
Primary request: draw THREE tall raised cat-house structures in one horizontal row of three equal columns, transparent background, fully separated with generous gutters. Same visual size and same standing silhouette proportions for all three: each total object is about 1.7 times as high as wide. Long straight support pillars account for nearly HALF the overall height, like the reference lower-left house. NOT short squat toys.
Left column: pale cream rectangular cat house with arch entrance, mint edge trim and a flat upper viewing platform, four LONG simple vertical legs and a narrow simple pale mint ladder descending to the floor at the right.
Middle column: cream arch-roof cat hut with arch entrance on long straight pillars, tiny simple ladder reaching the floor.
Right column: cream A-frame pointed-roof cat hut, circular entry, on long straight pillars, tiny simple ladder reaching the floor.
Style: very simple flat storybook illustration with broad cream/light wood/mint planes, just two or three geometric shadow planes per object, warm pale yellow light. Match the reference's clean restrained geometry exactly. A little visible right side plane to match the room perspective. Delicate clean edges. No dense texture, no woodgrain lines, no 3D toy rendering, no thick outline, no extra accessories, no cat, no ball, no secondary scratching tower. Very simple light wood legs and large flat surfaces.
Composition: landscape sheet, exactly three evenly spaced TALL upright objects, identical baseline, full silhouettes entirely within each column, much blank space between objects, 3-column grid. Transparent through all gaps between legs and rungs. No opaque background, no white matte or fringe, no checkerboard drawn into image. No ground plane, no contact shadow outside objects, no text.

jobs.name: sheet-sofa-original-view-v3
jobs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: transparent sprite sheet for the RIGHT EDGE of the reference illustrated cat room.
Input image: original-room-1-1.png is the only style/composition/perspective reference. Closely examine the sofa at the extreme RIGHT EDGE: the viewer sees a tall narrow NEAR SIDE PANEL / near-side arm and only a small strip of seat above it; most sofa extends off-screen to the RIGHT. Reproduce THIS SAME SIDE-ON viewpoint, never a front-facing full chair.
Primary request: three alternate soft seats, each drawn as a NARROW SIDE-VIEW PROFILE, in three evenly separated columns. The furniture continues away to the RIGHT. We mainly see the near left side panel as a vertical slab in the foreground and a little seat/back above and behind it. Seat opening faces towards the LEFT, NOT towards the viewer. Only ONE arm is visible on armchair versions. DO NOT show a complete broad seat, do not show symmetrical two-arm chair, do not show a frontal product shot.
Left column: pale cream beanbag from its SIDE, tall soft tapering side profile, tiny hint of the depressed seat facing LEFT.
Middle column: blush peach low cushion chair with a softly scalloped cloud back, entirely SIDE VIEW, one broad near-side panel and one small visible strip of seat, cloud back rising behind towards the RIGHT.
Right column: muted mint low wraparound upholstered sofa, side profile with ONE dominant near side arm panel and only a narrow glimpse of seat above, pale cream piping, tiny dark short foot.
Style: reference's restrained flat storybook illustration, large solid cream/mint/soft peach color planes, only minimal geometric shading, clean simple flat cutout, no 3D rendering, no realistic fabric or dense texture, no black outline. Match warm sunlight palette.
Composition: one horizontal row, three equal columns, each independent TALL NARROW silhouette (height about 1.6 times width), full silhouette within its column, much transparent gutter between columns. They are side-view fragments suitable for a room's right edge, not complete front-facing seating. All bottoms aligned, no floor, no floating shadows, no background, actual clean transparent alpha, no white fringe, no drawn checkerboard, no text or logos.

packing: Chrome Canvas crops preserve source alpha and pixels. Alpha>=32 bounds used only to find visible content; all source pixels inside each crop preserved. 10px transparent margin added. No resizing, redraw, thresholding or background replacement.
